rows.name: href?
rows.notes: Stripped from the DOM while `disabled` — a prevented attribute can still be reached around (middle click, the context menu), an absent href cannot.

rows.name: external?
rows.notes: An outbound link: `target="_blank"` + `rel="noopener noreferrer"` by default, `data-external` on the root, and the externalIcon/externalLabel parts come alive.

rows.name: current?
rows.notes: `aria-current` — the router's hook for "you are here".

rows.name: underline?
rows.notes: Defaults to `"hover"` for `tint` and `"always"` for `plain`: a link in the colour of its surrounding text with no underline is not identifiable as a link at all (WCAG 1.4.1).

rows.name: focusableWhenDisabled?
rows.notes: Keeps the link reachable on Tab while disabled (`tabIndex 0` + `role="link"`).

rows.name: nativeLink?
rows.notes: False when the root is not a real `<a>` (a `span role="link"`). The adapter infers it from what it renders; it decides who synthesises Enter.

rows.name: onPress?
rows.notes: Auxiliary (analytics, JS-only links without an href). It never replaces the native or router navigation and never calls `preventDefault`.

rows.name: children?
rows.notes: The link text — what names the link, and the only thing that can.

rows.name: icon?
rows.notes: The outbound glyph: an inline SVG, never a text character — see above.

rows.name: externalLabel?
rows.notes: The "opens in a new tab" wording, hidden visually and read as part of the name. Empty counts as absent.
